examples.translation: After King Wu had died, the uncle from Guan and his younger brothers spread rumors throughout the state, saying: "The Duke of Zhou will do harm upon the young king." The Duke of Zhou went and remained in the eastern capital for two years, and only then were the criminals identified. Afterward, the Duke of Zhou composed a poem and presented it to King Cheng, naming it "The Owl". King Cheng yet still did not dare to reproach the Duke of Zhou.
